page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6.6xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual instance powered by x86_64 architecture running on a KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 12 physical cores with hyperthreading enabled, driven by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 48.0 GB of memory, establishing a 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. Standard hardware instruction sets include AVX, AVX-512, AVX512_VNNI, AES encryption, and FMA. CPU cache specifications include 32 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and a shared 35 MB L3 cache.

Network connectivity features an 8 Gbps baseline bandwidth. The instance carries no local persistent storage and zero dedicated GPUs, relying entirely on network-attached block storage for disk operations. Benchmark evaluation places single-threaded CPU operations and single-threaded gzip compression in the lower quartile performance bracket. Conversely, multi-threaded workloads, including Geekbench multi-core, bzip3 decompression, PassMark CPU suites, and Redis SET operations, deliver average performance metrics. The compute-dense core configuration renders this server well-matched for web serving, software build compilation, and parallelized multi-threaded backend processes.
